description:
Search The Gazette's corporate insolvency notices by company name.

Searches The Gazette's corporate-insolvency notice index (category 24)
using the authoritative Gazette notice-code taxonomy. Results are sorted
by an internal DD severity score; the notice label itself remains a
source fact.

Corporate only. Personal insolvency (bankruptcy, IVAs, sequestrations,
trust deeds) is not covered, so an empty result says nothing about any
individual, such as a director or PSC. The Individual Insolvency
Register covers England and Wales only; Scottish sequestrations and
trust deeds are on the Accountant in Bankruptcy register, and Northern
Ireland has its own register.

One call reads one page of at most 100 feed entries (page, 1-based);
it never fetches further pages. upstream_total is the feed's count of
matching corporate notices (null when the feed does not say), and
is_partial is true when matches remain after this page (the count
exceeds the entries on this and earlier pages), or when the count is
unknown. The severity sort and max_notices cap apply within the page,
so the most severe notices shown are the most severe on this page,
not across every match.

skipped_unrecognised counts entries on this page whose notice code is
not a known corporate code, and unrecognised_codes lists those codes.
They are a diagnostic for codes the taxonomy does not label yet, not a
sign of personal insolvency coverage.

Each result includes a notice_numeric_id. Read the full legal wording
via the notice://{notice_numeric_id} resource.

The Gazette is the official UK public record. A notice here means
the event has been formally published. This tool does not establish its legal effect.

end_date.description: Filter notices up to this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

entity_name.description: Deprecated alias for name: the company name to search for.

max_notices.description: Cap on notices returned from this page, applied after the severity/date sort. Default 20. One call reads one page of at most 100 feed entries, so 100 removes the cap for that page (notice_type and code filters still apply); it does not reach every match: compare upstream_total and use page to read further.

name.description: Company name to search for in Gazette corporate insolvency notices

notice_type.description: Filter by Gazette notice code (e.g. '2450' petition to wind up a company, '2452' winding-up order, '2410' appointment of administrators). Omit to search all.

page.description: 1-based page of the Gazette feed to read (100 entries per page). Default 1. Use with upstream_total to read past the first 100 matches.

query.description: Alias for name: the company name to search for.

name: gazette_insolvency

outputSchema.description: Aggregated Gazette insolvency notice search result.

end_date.description: Upper bound of the date range filter, if any.

is_partial.description: True when matches remain after this page (upstream_total exceeds the feed entries on this and earlier pages), or when upstream_total is unknown. Notices dropped by notice_type or max_notices do not set it. Re-call with page+1 to read on.

max_notices_cap.description: The max_notices cap applied. Upstream may have more matching notices.

notice_type_filter.description: Notice code filter applied, or null if all codes searched.

notices.description: Matching notices from this page, sorted by severity (desc) then date (desc).

items.description: A single corporate insolvency notice from The Gazette.

content.description: Brief notice excerpt from the search feed (HTML stripped). For full legal wording read notice://{notice_numeric_id}.

notice_code.description: Gazette notice code (e.g. '2450' petition to wind up a company, '2452' winding-up order for a company).

notice_numeric_id.description: Numeric notice ID. Read full notice content via the notice://{notice_numeric_id} resource.

severity.description: Internal severity score 0-10. Higher = more serious (10 = winding-up order, 9 = administration/receiver/liquidator appointment, 0 = informational or unclassified).

page.description: The 1-based feed page read by this call (up to 100 entries per page).

skipped_unrecognised.description: Feed entries on this page dropped because their notice code is not a known corporate insolvency code. Counted before the notice_type filter and max_notices cap. 0 when none.

start_date.description: Lower bound of the date range filter, if any.

total_notices.description: Notices returned by this call, after the notice_type filter, sorting, and cap. Not the feed total (see upstream_total).

unrecognised_codes.description: The distinct notice codes behind skipped_unrecognised, sorted. Empty when none. These are not personal insolvency results: this tool covers corporate insolvency only.

upstream_total.description: The Gazette feed's count of matching corporate insolvency notices (f:total), across all pages and before the local notice_type filter. Null when the feed does not report it (unknown, not zero).

title: Search Gazette Corporate Insolvency Notices
